'''Shardsnail''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Gemsnail]] at 6 bronze stars.

== Overview ==
Current Description: "The crystals on Shardsnail are the result of an infectious ore disease, but it's not contagious. Aside from making the shell a bit heavier, there seems to be no harm. Just think of it as a glittery makeover, Shardsnail."

Shardsnail is a purple rarity Tatari that trades damage potential to wall enemies with a unique summon.

== Appearance ==
Shardsnail's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form recolors the purple amethyst on its shell into an emerald green color.

== Evolution Trial ==
Shardsnail's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Gemsnail]], you need to complete the following task:
* Obtain 5 shield via pinball.

== Strategy ==
[[File:Shardsnail Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Shardsnail's Attack Range]]
Shardsnail's crystal is summoned one tile ahead of the furthest deployable row. Since the crystal inherits Shardsnail's high DEF stat, it's guaranteed to survive for a respectable amount of time.

Outside of this however, Shardsnail will likely deal less damage than the other Rock DPS Tataris. It would be best to supplement its poor offense with other DPS options, such as [[Punchimp]] or [[Mudrump]]/[[Rockhog]].
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "The crystals on Shardsnail are the result of an infectious ore disease, but it's not contagious."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/2026, its bio description said: "The small amethyst on Shardsnail's shell shines in the dark. Shardsnail is extremely slow and frequently loses track of destinations."
